visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In the first phase, a young girl with pigtails and a white shirt stands in a pink-themed exhibition booth. She is smiling while holding a large, beige bear-shaped cardboard cutout. The background features colorful signage and product displays for stickers. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor location with a long line of people holding umbrellas under a bright sun. The camera pans across the crowd waiting in front of a modern building with glass facades and industrial streetlights against a blue sky. (3) A high-angle shot shows a massive crowd of people with colorful umbrellas in a large paved plaza. The setting is bright and sunny, highlighting the urban architecture and green space in the distance. The overall vibe is a busy public event. (4) The woman and child are seen in a medium close-up, waving excitedly at the camera. They are standing outdoors in front of the ICC Tainan building. Both characters wear white T-shirts and display happy, enthusiastic facial expressions in natural daylight. (5) A red screen appears with white text displaying "2025年 臺北文博會". This is followed by another red screen with the character "備". These are graphic overlays serving as a transition. The lighting is flat and the style is minimalist graphic design. (6) The camera returns to a close-up of the woman with black hair speaking directly to her phone. She is indoors in a brightly lit hallway or entrance area. She wears a beige blazer and a black polka-dot top, looking earnest and engaged. (7) The woman laughs while making a peace sign, then the camera pans to show a large event hall. People are seated at tables in a workspace-like environment. The lighting is bright and industrial, with many attendees visible in the background. (8) In the final phase, the woman is filmed from a low angle as she rides an upward-moving escalator. She continues her narration with a smile, looking into the lens. The background shows the modern interior of a shopping mall or terminal.

It highlights the booth selection process to engage followers and build anticipation for their upcoming appearance.
